snippet.title: Absolum - Official Cider Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Meet Cider and see the character in action in this new Absolum trailer for the upcoming roguelite beat ‘em up game. Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh. Absolum will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch, PS5 (PlayStation 5), and PS4 (PlayStation 4) in 2025. A demo will be available at Steam Next Fest from June 9 to June 16, 2025.
